card.name: Words before level or quality descriptors
card.fires_on: Small linking or degree words (of, higher, very, more, fully, genuine) that come just before a noun of quality or level, such as civilisation, education, grades or fields. Mostly in old-style descriptive prose.

modes.label: of before quality
modes.description: The word 'of' leads into a noun describing level or character.
modes.example: It has also a high school<< of>> ten grades, a private bank, a

modes.label: degree adjectives
modes.description: Words like higher, very, more or genuine come before a noun of standard or refinement.
modes.example: They were speedily followed by other races, of<< higher>> civilisation, perhaps of the same family

modes.label: the before fields
modes.description: 'the' comes before a list of fields of study or work.
modes.example: conducts basic research in<< the>> fields of biochemistry, genetics and evolutionary

card.writes: It nudges the model toward words like culture and grade, which name level or cultural standing.
card.plain: It fires on small words just before a term for the level, grade or refinement of something, like 'of higher civilisation'.
